survival_guides.label: Survival Guides
survival_guides.summary: Survival Guide NPCs (home-point style travel/registration NPCs) across the field zones: one tracked row per guide with its DSP npc id, position, whether the id is DAT-verified, whether it is present in the live DB, and your in-game validation mark (visible, clickable, positioned on navmesh).
survival_guides.compare: Verify each id against a fresh DAT pull (entity name 'Survival Guide'), run !checknav on the position, then mark it ok in game.
